note: Items players saw in game whose tooltip no upload or site has yet: name and slot as the player read them, no stats. tools/scavenge_items.py adds them to the item database with that source line until a real tooltip arrives (a players' upload or ForeverChanges), which then wins. Keys are item ids; el is the client's inventory type, c and u its item class and subclass, b the build, at the date, where the place.
